_comment: Two pins, advanced independently. 'baseline' is upstream LLVM carrying only the required patches; 'extended' is the commit every extension has been rebased onto. Upgrading moves baseline first, then extended once the extensions apply again -- so a stale extension no longer blocks trying a newer LLVM. Keep baseline's hash stable unless you mean to move it: it is the default build and the CI cache key.

upstream._comment: Deprecated alias for baseline, kept so an older checkout's tooling still resolves a pin. Remove once nothing reads it.
